name: Banality Man
source:
Can one man solve all the world's problems with nothing more than his fists? Probably not, but goshdarnit, he's gonna try.

When a woman can't get her medicine, Banality Man vows to make things better -- with his fists!

Will he fight his way through the America's healthcare system, attempting to punch bureaucracy in the face, or will he go help the woman, attempting to punch her health problems in the face? You decide.

[From [url=https://yossarianiii.itch.io/banality-man] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个人仅靠拳头就能解决世界上所有的问题吗？可能不会，但是天哪，他会尝试的。

当一个女人拿不到药时，平庸的男人发誓要用拳头让事情变得更好！

他会在美国的医疗保健系统中奋力拼搏，试图打击官僚主义，还是会去帮助那位女士，试图打击她的健康问题？你决定。

[来自[url=https://yossarianiii.itch.io/banality-man] itch.io[/url]]
